configuracoes.funcao.descoberta_cc_ligad: When off, discovery does not run. Suggestions already made stay on screen.
configuracoes.funcao.paginas_ligadas.aju: When off, no page is checked.
configuracoes.funcao.enriquecimento_liga: When off, job detail pages are not fetched, and the sitemap sources bring no new jobs.
configuracoes.funcao.destaques_ligados.a: When off, the tab goes away and the panel opens on All.

configuracoes.funcao.regras_ocultar_liga: When off, nothing is hidden by rule. Hiding by hand still works.
configuracoes.funcoes.destaques_n.ajuda: How many jobs the Highlights tab shows, from 1 to 100.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.explicacao: With background on, joBot starts by itself with your user session and looks for jobs while you do something else.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.nao_suportad: Background mode does not exist on this system yet: it comes in a future version. For now it stays off.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.ligar.ajuda: Creates the service that starts joBot when you sign in (systemd on Linux, Task Scheduler on Windows). Turning it off removes the service.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.recusa: Could not change the background setting.
configuracoes.erro.segundo_plano_arquivo: I could not write the service files. It may be a permission or disk space problem (details in the log).
configuracoes.aparencia.explicacao: Theme, language and text size apply to the whole panel and are kept on this computer.
configuracoes.aparencia.ajuda_pais: Used for searches without a city and to pick the currency. The panel language is chosen separately.
configuracoes.privacidade.onde: Everything stays on this computer, in the folder:
configuracoes.privacidade.telemetria: joBot has no account and no ads: no telemetry and none of your data is sent. It only makes network requests in these cases: to the public job sources you leave on (they all come on), including each job's page; to the Central Bank of Brazil, to get the exchange rates of the currencies in the jobs and show salaries in the display currency you choose, with currency conversion on (it comes on); to Common Crawl, once a week, to discover new companies, and then to those companies' job boards, to check them (it comes on); to the pages you ask it to follow (it comes on, but with no pages on the list there is no request); to the sites with login you turn on (they come off), through the browser, with your account; to Playwright's servers, to download the browser, only when you press "Download" in Tools or, in the desktop app, check it during installation (joBot does not distribute the browser; it comes from Playwright) or update joBot with it already downloaded; to 2Captcha, only when you test the key in Settings, Services, or, while browsing with login, with the key saved and the switch on (comes off); to Gmail (Google), over a read-only IMAP connection, only when you save or check the app password in Settings, Accounts (with no app password there is no request); to the AI services you set up (Anthropic API, OpenAI, Google Gemini or the compatible address you type), with the title and text of the jobs, only when you turn on an AI task on one of them in Settings, AI (the tasks come off), and in the test when you turn it on; the local model makes no network request; to GitHub and Hugging Face, with their CDNs, to download the local model (llama-server and the Qwen model), only when you press "Download", "Switch" or "Update" on the model card in Tools, check it during installation or run jobot ferramentas baixar (or atualizar) ia-local; to a company's website, only when you paste an address, test it or accept a suggestion; to the internet through git and uv (or to GitHub, when joBot came from the installer), to download the new joBot version, only when you ask to update (the Update now button or the jobot atualizar command). With the version notice below on, it also asks GitHub (it comes on; you can turn it off). Whoever receives a request sees your computer's IP address, as with any internet request.
configuracoes.privacidade.disco: Your data sits in ordinary files. We recommend turning on disk encryption on your computer, so nobody can read the folder above if the device is lost.
configuracoes.privacidade.aviso_versao: Tell me when a new version is out
configuracoes.privacidade.aviso_versao.a: It comes on: once a day joBot asks GitHub for the latest version. The request carries no search or personal data, only your IP, like any request on the internet. When off, this notice makes no request.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.frase: Solves CAPTCHAs for you when browsing with a login, on the sites you turn on in Settings, Accounts.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.usar.ajud: Off, joBot stops and waits for you to solve it, as always.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.chave.aju: The key stays in the system password vault and never comes back to the screen. Leave it empty to keep the saved key.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.no_arquiv: This computer has no password vault available. The key was kept in a file that only your user can read, in the data folder.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.aviso.log: It only applies to browsing with a login, on the sites you turn on in Settings, Accounts. Public sources never use it.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.aviso.ter: Solving CAPTCHAs may go against some sites' terms, and your account there may be restricted.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.aviso.cus: Each solve costs money from your 2Captcha account. joBot stops after {teto} per day.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.aviso.dad: Only the page address, the challenge's public code and the browser's user agent go to 2Captcha. No personal data.
configuracoes.servicos.erro.formato: The key must have 16 to 64 letters and numbers, with no spaces. Nothing was saved.
configuracoes.servicos.erro.cofre: I could not store or delete the key. The details are in jobot.log.
configuracoes.servicos.erro.sem_chave: Type a key or save one before testing.
configuracoes.servicos.ia.nada_sai: Saving the key turns nothing on: job text only goes to the service when you turn on an AI task.
configuracoes.servicos.ia.anthropic.fras: Billed per use, on your Anthropic account. Create the key tied to a workspace in the console: without a workspace, every request is refused. A 402 error is billing: check the account's credit.
configuracoes.servicos.ia.openai.frase: Billed per use, on your OpenAI account.
configuracoes.servicos.ia.gemini.frase: May be billed per use, depending on your Google AI Studio account plan.
configuracoes.servicos.ia.compativel.fra: A server that speaks the OpenAI API, such as Ollama or LM Studio on your computer. joBot does not install them.
configuracoes.servicos.ia.compativel.sal: Save the address and the key
configuracoes.servicos.ia.compativel.apa: Delete the address and the key
configuracoes.servicos.ia.endereco.ajuda: Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. LM Studio: http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1. Outside your computer, https only.
configuracoes.servicos.ia.erro.chave: The key must have 8 to 512 characters, with no spaces or accents. Nothing was saved.
configuracoes.servicos.ia.erro.endereco: The address must start with https:// (http:// only on your computer: 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1) and cannot have a user, password, ? or #. Nothing was saved.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.explicacao: Reading sites with login may go against their terms, and your account may be restricted. You decide site by site. joBot never types your password and only reads: you sign in to the site and it reads the jobs from that session, only on the sites you turn on here.
No browser found. Install Google Chrome or download the browser in Tools.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.horarios.a: 1 to 4 times in the HH:MM format, separated by commas, at least 4 hours apart. Example: 09:00, 18:00.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.horarios.f: Use the HH:MM format, separating the times with commas (for example 09:00, 18:00).
configuracoes.sites_com_login.horarios.p: Leave at least 4 hours between one time and the next.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.em_andamen: A reading is in progress; try again when it finishes.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.agua: Sign in to the site and close the window when you are done. joBot then checks the sign-in by itself (the window closes after {minutos} minutes if left open).
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.pron: Signed in. joBot can now read this site.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.nao_: Could not confirm the sign-in. Try again and sign in before closing the window.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.temp: The window stayed open for {minutos} minutes without a sign-in and was closed. Try again.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.sem_: Could not find the computer's screen to open the browser. Try again with the desktop session open.
No browser found. Install Google Chrome or download the browser in Settings, Tools, and try again.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.em_u: joBot's browser is already open. Close it and try again.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.erro: Something went wrong opening the browser. The details are in jobot.log.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.esquecer.p: Delete the logins for all sites?
configuracoes.sites_com_login.esquecer.e: joBot deletes its browser folder, with the sessions of every site. Your jobs stay. To read these sites again, sign in again.
Could not delete the logins. The details are in jobot.log.
configuracoes.ferramentas.explicacao: Programs joBot downloads separately, only when you ask.
configuracoes.ferramentas.navegador.tama: About 210 MB to download, from Playwright's servers, and about 420 MB on disk.
configuracoes.ferramentas.navegador.desa: Out of date: the last joBot update could not bring the new browser version. Download it again to keep the sites with login working.
configuracoes.ferramentas.estado.chrome: joBot uses this computer's Google Chrome. Nothing to download, and joBot does not touch it.
configuracoes.ferramentas.dica_baixando: It can take a few minutes; joBot keeps working.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.pronto: Browser downloaded. Sites with login can use it now.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.removido: Browser removed. To use sites with login again, download it again.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.continua: Another program on this computer uses the same copy of the browser: it stays on disk, and joBot keeps using it.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.em_uso: A site with login is open right now. Wait for the reading or the login to finish and try again.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.falhou_b: Could not download the browser. Check your internet connection and free disk space and try again. The details are in joBot's log (jobot.log).
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.falhou_r: Could not remove the browser. Try again. The details are in joBot's log (jobot.log).
configuracoes.ferramentas.ia_local.frase: To use AI offline and for free: the job text stays on your computer.
configuracoes.ferramentas.ia_local.taman: {menor} to {maior} to download, depending on the computer's memory: the program comes from llama.cpp (GitHub) and the model from Hugging Face.
configuracoes.ferramentas.ia_local.recar: Refresh the page to see the progress
configuracoes.ferramentas.ia_local.desat: A new version of the model or the program is available. Update downloads only what changed.
configuracoes.ferramentas.ia_local.remov: Remove deletes the model and the program and turns off the AI tasks that use the local model.
configuracoes.ferramentas.ia_local.aviso: Local model ready. Turn tasks on in Settings › AI.
Local model removed. The tasks that used it were turned off.
Could not download the local model. {motivo} What already arrived is kept: trying again resumes where it stopped. The details are in joBot's log (jobot.log).
Could not remove the local model. {motivo} Try again. The details are in joBot's log (jobot.log).
configuracoes.ferramentas.ia_local.motiv: No internet, or the server did not answer.
Could not write the files to joBot's folder.
Another download of the local model is running.
There is no local model program for this computer, or it did not run here.
The requested model is not on joBot's list.
configuracoes.contas.explicacao: See whether joBot is still signed in to each site, and sign in again when needed.
configuracoes.contas.motivo.sem_rede: No internet, or the site did not answer.
configuracoes.contas.motivo.desafio: The site asked for an anti-robot check.
configuracoes.contas.motivo.sem_tela: No screen to open the browser.
configuracoes.contas.motivo.erro: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.
configuracoes.contas.ocupado: Something is already using the browser; try again in a moment.
configuracoes.contas.conferir_espera: Checked a moment ago. You can check again in a few minutes.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.explicacao: To let joBot check your Gmail, create an app password in your Google account and paste it here.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.acesso: An app password gives access to your whole mailbox. joBot only opens the inbox read-only.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.senha_guardad: An app password is saved. To change it, paste a new one.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.remover_expli: joBot stops checking Gmail. The password stays valid in your Google account until you revoke it there.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.tutorial: How to Create an App Password
configuracoes.contas.gmail.erro.endereco: Enter an email address, like name@gmail.com.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.erro.senha: An app password has 16 letters. Copy it again from the Google page.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.erro.recusada: Google refused the password. Check the address or create a new app password.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.erro.cofre: The system password vault did not respond.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.erro.nao_apag: The password was not removed. Try again.
configuracoes.contas.gmail.no_arquivo: No system password vault: the password is in a file only your user can read.
configuracoes.geral.versao.nao_conferida: Latest known version: not checked yet. With the version notice on (Settings › Privacy), joBot checks once a day.
configuracoes.geral.versao.em_dia: You have the newest version joBot knows about.
configuracoes.perfil.explicacao: Who you are and what you have done. It all stays on your computer and only goes to the AI you turn on. Each part has its own Save.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.ajuda: Up to 5 MB; joBot reads the first 20 pages on your computer. The PDF and its text are not saved.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.sem_js: To read the résumé, the panel needs JavaScript turned on. Without it, fill in the profile below.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.lido: Résumé read: {paginas} of {total} pages. Nothing was saved.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.grande: The file is over 5 MB. Send a smaller PDF.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.sem_taman: The browser did not send the file size. Reload the page and try again.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.aviso.nao: This file is not a PDF.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.aviso.sen: This PDF asks for a password to open. Save a copy without a password and try again.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.aviso.pro: This PDF has a protection joBot cannot open on this computer. Save or print an unprotected copy, as PDF, and try again.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.aviso.cor: Could not read this PDF: the file looks damaged.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.aviso.so_: This PDF has no text to read (it looks like images only, such as a scanned document). Fill in the profile by hand.
configuracoes.perfil.curriculo.aviso.pra: The PDF took more than 30 seconds to read and reading stopped. Try a smaller file.
configuracoes.perfil.habilidades.ajuda: One per line. Case, accents and repeats don't count twice.
configuracoes.perfil.privacidade.desliga: Your skills stay on your computer. AI is off: nothing leaves it.
configuracoes.perfil.privacidade.local: Your skills stay on your computer, and so does the job text: matching uses the local model.
configuracoes.perfil.privacidade.fora: Your skills stay on your computer; only the job text goes to {servico}.
configuracoes.perfil.erro.grande: Up to 200 skills, each up to 100 characters.
configuracoes.perfil.apagar.explicacao: Your details, languages, skills, experience, courses, answers and prepared applications are removed from joBot. What AI already read from the jobs stays.
configuracoes.perfil.contato.ajuda: joBot does not put these fields in requests to AI.
configuracoes.perfil.cargo: Current job title (or the last one)
configuracoes.perfil.anos: Years of experience in your field
configuracoes.perfil.resumo.ajuda: A few lines about you and what you do.
configuracoes.perfil.links.ajuda: One per line, with http:// or https://. Up to 10.
configuracoes.perfil.experiencias.explic: Your most important jobs and projects, up to 10.
configuracoes.perfil.experiencia.fim.aju: Empty if it is your current job.
configuracoes.perfil.cursos.explicacao: Degree, technical or short course, up to 10.
configuracoes.perfil.erro.anos: Years of experience: a number from 0 to 60.
configuracoes.perfil.erro.email: Check the email: the @ or the domain is missing.
configuracoes.perfil.erro.links: One link per line, starting with http:// or https://, up to 10.
configuracoes.perfil.erro.longo: One of the fields is over the maximum length.
configuracoes.perfil.erro.nivel: Choose the level of each language you typed.
configuracoes.perfil.erro.cargo: Type the job title of the experience.
configuracoes.perfil.erro.mes: Dates as YYYY-MM, with the start before the end.
configuracoes.ia.explicacao: AI reads job postings and lists what each one asks for, so matching can compare it with the skills in your profile. It is optional and comes turned off: nothing leaves your computer until you turn it on.
configuracoes.ia.atalho.desligada.ajuda: Nothing leaves your computer. This is the default.
configuracoes.ia.atalho.offline.ajuda: Uses the local model: job texts stay on your computer and it costs nothing.
configuracoes.ia.atalho.offline.baixar: Download the local model in Tools
configuracoes.ia.atalho.claude.ajuda: Anthropic API, billed per use. Experimental, not yet proven.
configuracoes.ia.atalho.claude.chave: Add the Anthropic key in Services
configuracoes.ia.personalizado.explicaca: Choose, task by task, where AI runs and with which model.
configuracoes.ia.tarefa.encaixe: Matching: what each job asks for
configuracoes.ia.tarefa.encaixe.ajuda: After each search, reads up to 20 new jobs that already match a search.
configuracoes.ia.sem_backend: There is nowhere to run it yet: add a key in Services or download the local model in Tools.
configuracoes.ia.modelo.ajuda: On the Anthropic API, claude-haiku-5-5 or claude-sonnet-5-5 (empty uses the default). On other services, the model name as the service calls it. On the local model, the downloaded one is used.
configuracoes.ia.privacidade.desligada: Off: job texts do not leave your computer.
configuracoes.ia.privacidade.local: Job texts stay on your computer: it uses the local model.
configuracoes.ia.cobrado: Billed per use, on your account with the service.
configuracoes.ia.experimental: Experimental, not yet proven: only tested without the real service.
configuracoes.ia.hoje: Requests to this service: {n} of {teto} today.
configuracoes.ia.sem_servico: Set up {servico} in Services: until then, the task stays stopped.
configuracoes.ia.sem_servico.local: Download the local model in Tools: until then, the task stays stopped.
configuracoes.ia.custo.titulo: Turn on matching on a paid service?
configuracoes.ia.custo.texto: Chosen service: {servico}. It bills per use: with matching on, joBot makes up to {teto} requests a day to it, one per new job that matches a search.
configuracoes.ia.erro.sem_backend: To turn it on, choose where AI runs.
configuracoes.ia.erro.modelo: Type the model name: up to 200 characters, no spaces.
configuracoes.ia.erro.modelo_claude: On the Anthropic API, only claude-haiku-5-5 or claude-sonnet-5-5.
configuracoes.ia.falha.sem_chave: This service has no key. Add the key in Settings › Services.
configuracoes.ia.falha.chave_recusada: The service refused the key. Check the key in Settings › Services.
configuracoes.ia.falha.chave_recusada.an: Anthropic refused the key. Check the key (it must be tied to a workspace) or the billing in the Anthropic console.
configuracoes.ia.falha.sem_rede: Could not reach the service. Check the internet and the address and try again.
configuracoes.ia.falha.programa_ausente: The local model program did not open. Download it again in Settings › Tools.
configuracoes.ia.falha.modelo_ausente: The service does not know this model, or the local model was not downloaded. Check the model name or download it in Settings › Tools.
configuracoes.ia.falha.tempo_esgotado: The service took too long to answer. Try again later.
configuracoes.ia.falha.limite: The service said the limit was reached or credit is missing. Wait a while or check your account with the service.
configuracoes.ia.falha.esquema_recusado: The service does not accept schema output with this model. Try another model.
configuracoes.ia.falha.servico_fora: The service is down or answered with an error. Try again later.
configuracoes.ia.falha.recusa: The model did not answer in the requested format. Try another model.
configuracoes.ia.falha.formato: The model's answer did not fit the format. Try another model.
configuracoes.ia.falha.contexto: The text is longer than the model accepts. Try a model with a larger context.
configuracoes.ia.teste.testando: Testing: joBot makes a short request, with a made-up job, and waits for the answer (with the local model, the first time can take a few minutes).
configuracoes.ia.teste.recarregar: Reload the page to see the test result.
configuracoes.ia.teste.ok: ✓ Tested: the answer came in the right format.
configuracoes.ia.teste.falhou: The test failed and the task was turned off. {motivo} Then turn it on again to test once more.
